thread:
FinanceOps: Morning — nightly reconciliation surfaced ~260 NetSuite records flagged as 'refund applied' but Stripe shows no matching refund event. Report: /reports/billing/seq_gap_2025-10-12.csv
Ravi: Looking at webhook logs: several Stripe events arrived out-of-order due to multi-worker delivery; our consumer relies on incremental sequence processing per-customer but doesn't persist last-processed-event-id atomically. When a later event (refund) is processed before the invoice update, export imported a credit memo without the invoice context.
Tess: Confirmed locally: stripe.event.sequence numbers: 1024, 1026, 1025 delivered; we applied 1026 then 1025 which triggered a stale state path.
Gabe: Accounting sees 3 mid-size customers impacted (one $4.3k). We need a careful reconcile and a stop-gap to prevent further misorders.
Ravi: Hotfix plan: (1) add per-customer event_lock + last_event_id persisted; consumer checks last_event_id < incoming.seq before applying, otherwise requeue with short delay. (2) add stripe_event_id to net_credits with unique index to avoid duplicates. Small patch + migration in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/722
Tess: For reconciliation: generate CSV with net_record_id, ns_batch_id, stripe_event_id (if present), amount, suggested_action (reverse_net_or_keep), confidence. We'll run manual approve for >$1k.
Accounting: Please include invoice numbers and customer contact info in CSV. No automated NetSuite reversals for >$5000 without two approvals.
Stripe-Webhook-Bot: Note: Stripe retry window 2025-10-12 02:00-02:15 UTC saw 18 retries due to transient network flaps. Might correlate.
Gabe: I'll run dry-run matcher and upload CSV to FIN-2890. Plan maintenance window 19:00-19:30 PT to run reversals for confirmed items.
Ravi: Also implement short-lived DLQ for events that look out-of-order so we don't lose them. We'll canary to 5% traffic after tests. deploy-bot: canary/webhooks started 2025-10-12T15:02Z :rocket:
FinanceOps: Action items: (A) dry-run CSV + upload (Gabe), (B) deploy consumer guard + unique index (Ravi), (C) manual NetSuite reversal during window (Accounting + Ops), (D) postmortem & alert on out-of-order rate >0.1%. Keep updates here.
